item.title: Urgent: Health and Safety Hazard – Fallen Leaves and Tree Branches on Pavement, 22nd November
item.description:
I am writing to report a health and safety concern regarding the accumulation of fallen leaves and tree branches on the pavement. The pavement has become obstructed and potentially hazardous for pedestrians. The fallen leaves can become wet and slippery, increasing the risk of people slipping and falling. In addition, the fallen tree branches present a further risk of injury and may obstruct safe pedestrian access, particularly for elderly residents, children, wheelchair users and people with limited mobility. This situation is a health and safety hazard and requires urgent attention to prevent potential accidents or injuries. I would therefore appreciate it if arrangements could be made as soon as possible to clear the fallen leaves and remove the branches, ensuring that the pavement is left clean, clear and safe for public use. Please treat this matter as a priority and confirm when the necessary maintenance and clearance work will be carried out. Thank you for your attention. I look forward to your prompt response.

item.title: Chichester Road, 22nd November
item.description:
For the past 4 years whenever it rains a huge area of the pavement and the road get covered with water for days. The gully is sitting at a higher point and the water is fully trapped. Thousands of children, commuters, elderly pass from this pavement every day and walk in the middle of the street. An accident is waiting to happen. It is completely unacceptable. A new gully needs to be put in the right place and the pavement restored. The pavements were fully rennovated around the new builts, but no maintenance whatsoever to the last part leading to the tube station.
